messages:
amanda_sales: Quick sync — ACME POC runway. Need to lock scope, success criteria, and auth/quotas for engineering signoff.
rajesh_se: TL;DR from acme: two endpoints (chat + embeddings), streaming for chat, 50 concurrent users in peak, SLA target p95 <= 200ms token latency.
liang_infra: For dedicated vs hosted: if they need 50 concurrent streaming connections we should evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity; hosted can work with burst but cost will spike.
amanda_sales: Customer prefers hosted to avoid infra ops but asks for a committed rate plan if we can guarantee throughput. Pricing question — what tiers map to 50 concurrents + 1M tokens/day?
sophia_ps: I'll sketch a prelim cost estimate: estimate depends on batching and KV cache. Can you share expected prompt length and average tokens/response?
mike_acme_corp: Typical chat = 80 tokens prompt, 150 tokens reply. Embeddings calls ~512 tokens per request but low frequency (5k/day).
rajesh_se: Good. Success criteria proposal: 1) integration done end-to-end (SDK auth + streaming) within 2 weeks 2) p95 latency < 250ms for chat 3) embedding cosine > 0.78 on eval set 4) no auth failures after initial smoke tests.
liang_infra: Auth options: API keys + per-route quotas is fastest. If they require enterprise SSO we can enable OAuth + RBAC, but that adds ~3 days. For pilot, API key scoped to env + IP allowlist.
sophia_ps: Quotas: recommend rate limits of 25 reqs/sec for chat streaming per API key initially, with token-based throttling. We can set burst window and 429 semantics. SDK supports client-side backoff.
rajesh_se: Streaming notes: use the SDK streaming websocket for best latency. Client must implement reconnect + resume using stream_id header. Retries: idempotent chat messages need dedupe tokens; send `client_id` header and server will return 409 if duplicate.
mike_acme_corp: Do you have sample code for streaming + retry logic? We want minimal work on our side.
amanda_sales: Rajesh — can you drop a short example snippet and config we recommend? Also make a one-page POC checklist for customer.
rajesh_se: Sure. Snippet:
```
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'rwd-medium', conversation_id: 'pilot-123' });
stream.on('data', chunk => render(chunk));
stream.on('end', () => console.log('done'));
// on reconnect: pass stream_id to resume
```
Retry guidance: exponential backoff (base 200ms, max 5s), max 3 retries; on 429 include `Retry-After` honor.
liang_infra: For quotas and billing: if they commit to reserved capacity we can offer a discounted token rate and guarantee throughput. I need an estimate of QPS and average tokens to map to GPUs.
sophia_ps: I'll prepare a two-week POC plan, cost scenarios (hosted burst vs reserved), and the checklist. Action items: Rajesh — provide code + recommended rate limits; Sophia — draft cost table; Liang — run capacity estimate; Amanda — send to ACME and confirm timeline.
amanda_sales: Great. Mike, any blockers from your side for the 2-week timeline?
mike_acme_corp: No blockers. We'll allocate one eng and one infra person. Target start Monday. Please send the checklist and sample code today.
deploy-bot: Deployment triggered: create-temp-api-key for project acme-poc (expires in 14 days).
amanda_sales: Thanks all — will follow up with the checklist and estimated costs by EOD.
